name: ZERITH-H1
summary:
ZERITH H1 is a wheeled-arm robot designed for mobile manipulation, commercial services, household assistance and data collection. Its articulated body combines movement through a workspace with arms intended to reach and handle objects at different heights.

ZERITH's official presentation lists 19 degrees of freedom and a stated body reach extending from ground level to 2.20 metres. Those figures describe the manufacturer's configuration. H1 should be distinguished from Z1, the company's bipedal humanoid, when comparing mobility, control requirements and application suitability.
